clusters.description: Explicit cluster names. Omit to select by labelSelector.

concurrency.description: How many clusters to query at once.

deadline.description: Overall budget for the whole fan-out, e.g. "60s". On expiry the clusters that finished are returned; the rest are reported as timed out.

end.description: Range end for mode "range". Defaults to now.

labelSelector.description: Select clusters whose labels all match, e.g. {"env":"prod"}. One of clusters or labelSelector is required unless the fleet is small.

maxSeriesPerCluster.description: Maximum series to keep from each cluster. Deliberately small: 100 clusters times 20 series would defeat every other budget here. Aggregate in the expression instead.

onError.description: What to do when some clusters fail.

query.description: PromQL expression to run on every selected cluster. It is validated once at the hub before dispatch.

start.description: Range start for mode "range". Relative ("now-6h") or RFC 3339. Defaults to now-1h.

step.description: Resolution for mode "range". Omit to let the hub choose one step common to every cluster; the applied step is reported in downsampled.

time.description: Evaluation instant for mode "instant". Relative ("now-15m") or RFC 3339. Defaults to now.
